summary: Delek US Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on April 20, 2026, announcing the Board's approval of a $0.255 per share quarterly dividend, payable May 8, 2026, to shareholders of record May 1, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or other special situation event was disclosed. The filing is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation requiring classification under the defined categories.
